entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-09
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Embedded Views in ASP.NET Core 10 #64715
  • `HubException` message is always "wrapped", contrary to documentation #64714
  • HTTP 400 for negotiate call in Blazor Web App (InteractiveServerSideRendering(prereindering:false) #64713
  • Publishing a blazor wasm, that is served from a backend (through project include), does not populate the importmap #64709
  • Unable to call JavaScript in onintialized, new Exception about not being allowed to call JS in static mode #64707
  • Uploading via InputFile is much slower on Android #64706
  • Benchmark stopped running: QueryCompilation #64705
  • Perf regression: fortunes, fortunes_ef, json_middleware #64704

Closed

  • [Blazor] Accept the `blazor.web.js` startup options format in `blazor.{server|webassembly}.js` #51611
    Backlog
  • [API Proposal] APIs for Manual CRL Inspection and Validation for Certificate Revocation List #64710
  • net10, when postman submit 1+ files, ReadNextSectionAsync never return null, but in net9 is normal #64708
  • Add Docker support to Blazor Web App template #49889
    Backlog
  • [Auth] (AddMicrosoftAccount) handler returning 404 sometimes - since last week #64703
